competences.description: Attacks the enemy to stun for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to deal damage, ties the target's shadow, and increases your Attack Bar by 100%. Whenever the target is hit with a single-target attack, 50% of the damage from the first hit is dealt to all other enemies. The tie effect can be applied to one target at a time, and gets untied if either the tied enemy or you get defeated. It does not apply to boss battles.

effets.description: Whenever the target is hit with a single-target attack, 50% of the damage from the first hit is dealt to all other enemies. The tie effect can be applied to one target at a time, and gets untied if either the tied enemy or you get defeated.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Ignores Defense when attacking a target tied by the shadow, and decreases the damage taken from the tied target by 30%. Steals 1 beneficial effect whenever you attack the enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
